limits: Finite sequential sample: eight values per path. Wi-Fi and the requested 1 ms host wait are included. This is not throughput or stability qualification.
No warmup is removed. The protected first identity operation took 139.0548 ms and remains in the raw samples and mean. Medians average the middle pair.
Durable mode uses existing static OSCORE credentials and authenticated ordinary NVS. This is not an EDHOC or volatile-only security comparison.

Client per-operation state reads and commits are zero. Authenticated recovery and sender reservation precede measured operations. Device checkpoints remain required; device flash commit times and counts were not instrumented.
Unprotected checkpoint_ns measures a no-op policy boundary and clock overhead, not durable I/O.

Running heap capability views overlap. Payload allocation differs from total minus free, which includes allocator overhead. Dynamic stacks, TCBs, sockets and runtime already contribute; do not add the worker reservation again.

Task watermarks report lifetime minimum free space, not used bytes without each reservation. Four complete 12-task snapshots per cohort are retained. Startup, deleted tasks, ISR/kernel stacks and an absolute simultaneous peak are unmeasured.

Target server App size is unmeasured. The host App size of 33,448 B uses a different ABI and role. No server timing trace, hop separation, minimum deployment RAM, power-loss safety, reverse MCU initiator or cross-library MCU comparison is established.
The exact normal app was restored. No identity, credential or NVS snapshot was provisioned or restored. Legacy security counters advanced normally. Touch revalidation is deferred.
